selection_correction: The existing research plan specifies Modified IEEE33. SimBench is retained only as an alternative screen. See configs/modified_ieee33_candidate_v1.json.

benchmark.normal_topology: Native closed HV and MV bus couplers; both transformers in service. MV feeder open points preserved.
benchmark.upstream_grid: Native external-grid voltage boundary, not a simulated 110 kV network.

connection.provenance: Cable type/parameters from SimBench. New branch, 1 km length and three circuits are research assumptions, not a benchmark-original or installation-rated design.

aidc_interface.load_model: Balanced three-phase constant PQ in quasi-steady-state AC power flow
aidc_interface.power_factor_provenance: Explicit aggregate research assumption; not measured NLR PF or a claimed connection-code requirement.
aidc_interface.q_rule: Q_PCC = P_facility_after_TES * tan(acos(pf_facility)) + Q_ESS; calculate before ESS active power terms.
aidc_interface.p_rule: P_PCC = P_facility_after_TES + P_ESS_charge - P_ESS_discharge; import positive, export disabled.
aidc_interface.loss_boundary: Existing facility model already includes site-transformer/UPS losses. ESS is PCC-referred with effective efficiencies. Do not reapply these losses. DSO 110/20 kV transformers and new external feeder losses are separate upstream quantities.

tap_operating_assumption.mode: Fixed synchronized bank tap selected from a declared nominal point; not dynamic OLTC
tap_operating_assumption.selection_rule: Minimize absolute difference of main MV bus voltage from native autoTapSetp=1.025 among converged AC solutions; same tap on both parallel transformers. Do not select using ESS benefit or cap feasibility.
tap_operating_assumption.compatibility_note: Imported SimBench tap_changer_type=None and empty controller do not enact source autoTap metadata in this package combination. Ratio explicitly interprets native voltage-ratio taps; ratings, step size and range unchanged.
tap_operating_assumption.limits: Fixed nominal tap need not satisfy all high-generation/low-load states. Online tap regulation, deadband, delay and switching counts remain separate follow-up.

time_axis.future_alignment_rule: Repeat each 15-minute average into three 5-minute intervals, conserving energy; this does not create measured 5-minute variability.
time_axis.this_step: Static reference/stress snapshots only; no Azure-SimBench synchronized chronology or full 5-day network validation.

excluded: DSO OPF/DOE calculation and network-coupled ESS-TES optimization
N-1 security, cable installation design or thermal mutual derating certification
Protection, short-circuit, harmonics, power quality, FRT and dynamic grid-code compliance
Reactive flexibility or inverter apparent-power optimization
DFL, uncertain forecasts, rolling control and HIL
